tenderSchedule.title: Supply and Installation of 100 Nos Desktop Computers and 50 Nos Laptops to GBA-IT
tenderSchedule.description: Supply and Installation of 100 Nos Desktop Computers and 50 Nos Laptops to GBA-IT

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of Joint Commissioner, IT Section, GBA Head Office, NR Square, Bengaluru-560002

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have executed similar projects (Supply and Installation of Desktops computer and Laptops) of quantities as specified below in the last Five financial year 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25, and 2025-26 to any of the Karnataka State Government or Central Government departments or State/ Central Public Sector Units

The Bidder should be a registered company in India as per the Indian Companies Act 1956/ 2013 or Partnership firm as per Partnership Act 1932 or Proprietary Concern and is in the business for 5 years as on the date of publication of this RFP
The bidder/OEM should have valid EPEAT Gold/Silver, FCC, Energy Star, BIS certified. MIL-STD-810-G or better OEM should have ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- EPEAT Gold/Silver, FCC, Energy Star, BIS certified. MIL-STD-810-G or better OEM should have ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder and OEM should mandatorily satisfy all conditions mentioned in Karnataka Government Order No: FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bengaluru Dated 25/8/2020

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of declaration / certificate for the same to be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have a consolidated minimum positive Net Worth as on the last day of each of the preceding 5 financial years (financial year, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Charted Accountant Certificate specifying the Net Worth for the specified years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 2.80 crore, during last Five financial year, 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
